leadText:
Isis (Japanese: イシス Isis) is a who attended the Pokémon Training Center, and a character of the day who appeared in Bibarel Gnaws Best!.
 
Isis was temporarily appointed as the foreman of a stone bridge construction project after the expert stonecutter who was in charge injured his back. However, progress was notoriously slow after her refused to work due to the expert stonecutter's departure.

With three days left before the construction deadline and mounting pressures from the head engineer, Isis felt absolutely helpless. However, the expert stonecutter's return in Bibarel Gnaws Best! revealed the head engineer had deliberately cut corners in the planning and construction process, hence why Bibarel refused to work. After defeating the head engineer's Pokémon, Isis, , , and their Pokémon built the stone bridge on time and to the correct standard.
